decisions.statement: The registry is drawn from the emitted declarations rather than from the clone.
The declarations read are the ones `akasha temper eso generate declaration` writes.
A call naming no checkout reads and writes what `CODE_ROOT` names, else this repository.
A registry naming no constant of either kind refuses the call.
The registry is written where a page already claims that file.
The page beside the written file names the command that wrote the file.
The registry carries no prose of its own.
The registry lands as a mechanical change rather than written by this command.
A registry the checkout already has lands nothing and says so.
Both the file read and the file written are taken from the checkout named.
The rendering of the registry is in akasha.
A run that wrote before it threw says in its refusal what that run had written.
A fault carries the code that fault names and says where it was thrown.
